Container.Name: Unraid-Home
Container.Overview:
Self-populating homepage for your Unraid server. Scans Docker for containers and shows each one as a tile with its WebUI link, icon and status. Edit mode (from your home network) lets you rename, regroup, pin and hide tiles, add links and pages, and pick themes. Optional: login with authenticator sign-in, alerts (ntfy, Gotify, Discord, webhook, email), uptime and update badges, server stats, and automation for Nginx Proxy Manager and Cloudflare Tunnel so your apps get internet addresses automatically. All settings are optional.
Built entirely by AI (Claude, by Anthropic). Features are tested, but not every situation has been, so do your own due diligence before exposing it to the internet: keep the login on, use a strong password and 2FA, and review your Cloudflare, proxy and firewall settings. Use at your own risk.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the homepage is served on

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Used to discover containers (and, only if you turn on Container controls, to start/stop/restart them). Note: the read-only flag does not limit what the Docker API allows.

Config.Name: Unraid templates
Config.Description: Optional. Lets the hover summaries use each app's Overview text from its Unraid template. Read-only; only the name, repository, overview and category are read.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Stores your tile overrides and custom links

Config.Name: Update status file
Config.Description: Optional. Lets tiles show an Update badge for containers Unraid says are out of date. Read-only.

Config.Name: Disk stats: array
Config.Description: Optional. Read-only. Lets the stats strip show array usage.

Config.Name: Disk stats: cache
Config.Description: Optional. Read-only. Lets the stats strip show cache usage.

Config.Name: Page title
Config.Description: Heading shown at the top of the page

Config.Name: Server address
Config.Description: Optional. IP or hostname used in app links. Leave blank to use whatever address you opened the homepage with.

Config.Name: Show stopped containers
Config.Description: Show stopped containers (dimmed)

Config.Name: Only containers with a WebUI
Config.Description: true = hide containers that have no WebUI set in their Unraid template

Config.Name: Show Unraid link
Config.Description: Add a tile for the Unraid dashboard itself

Config.Name: Open in new tab
Config.Description: Open apps in a new browser tab

Config.Name: Read-only
Config.Description: true = hide the Edit button and block changes

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Login password (12+ characters). Leave blank to have one generated on first start; it is printed once in this container's log and stored only as a salted hash.

Config.Name: Remote domain
Config.Description: Optional. Your main domain (e.g. example.com). Every app with a web UI then gets https://<container-name>.example.com as its Remote URL automatically. Can also be set on the page in Edit mode.

Config.Name: Uptime checks
Config.Description: Check that each app's Remote URL answers over the internet and show a status dot on its tile.

Config.Name: Stats strip
Config.Description: Show CPU, memory, disk and uptime at the top of the page.

Config.Name: Alerts: ntfy URL
Config.Description: Optional. Full ntfy topic address (e.g. https://ntfy.sh/my-secret-topic) for alerts.

Config.Name: Alerts: Gotify URL
Config.Description: Optional. Gotify server address. Also set the Gotify token.

Config.Name: Alerts: Gotify token
Config.Description: Optional. Gotify app token.

Config.Name: Alerts: Discord webhook
Config.Description: Optional. Discord webhook address for alerts.

Config.Name: Alerts: generic webhook
Config.Description: Optional. Any address that accepts a JSON POST.

Config.Name: Email: SMTP server
Config.Description: Optional. Mail server for email alerts, e.g. smtp.gmail.com (Gmail needs an app password)

Config.Name: Email: port
Config.Description: Optional. 587 (STARTTLS, default), 465 (TLS) or 25 (plain relay)

Config.Name: Email: user
Config.Description: Optional. SMTP login (usually your email address)

Config.Name: Email: password
Config.Description: Optional. SMTP password. Gmail (and most providers with 2-step verification) require an app-specific password, not your normal password. Create a Gmail one at https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords (2-Step Verification must be on first).

Config.Name: Email: from
Config.Description: Optional. Sender address (defaults to the SMTP user)

Config.Name: Email: to
Config.Description: Optional. Who gets alerts; comma-separated addresses

Config.Name: NPM address
Config.Description: Optional. Nginx Proxy Manager admin address, e.g. http://192.168.xxx.xxx:7818. Lets Edit mode create proxy hosts for your apps.

Config.Name: NPM user
Config.Description: Optional. An Nginx Proxy Manager user (email) with permission to manage Proxy Hosts. Use a separate user without two-factor login.

Config.Name: NPM password
Config.Description: Optional. That user's password.

Config.Name: NPM forward address
Config.Description: Optional. Address Nginx Proxy Manager should forward to (your Unraid IP). Blank = the host in NPM address.

Config.Name: NPM automatic sync
Config.Description: true = every few minutes, create proxy hosts for new apps automatically (never edits or deletes existing ones).

Config.Name: Cloudflare API token
Config.Description: Optional. Token limited to this zone's DNS edit and the account's Tunnel edit (and Access edit if you use it). See the README.

Config.Name: Cloudflare account ID
Config.Description: Optional. Your Cloudflare account ID.

Config.Name: Cloudflare tunnel ID
Config.Description: Optional. The ID of your Cloudflare Tunnel.

Config.Name: Cloudflare Access emails
Config.Description: Optional. Comma-separated emails allowed through a Cloudflare Access login for the whole wildcard. Leave blank to skip Access.

Config.Name: Remote edits blocked
Config.Description: true = editing is only possible from your home network, not through a tunnel or reverse proxy

Config.Name: Allowed countries
Config.Description: Optional. Comma-separated 2-letter country codes (e.g. US,CA). Only these can reach the page from the internet. Needs Cloudflare (it supplies the country).

Config.Name: Blocked countries
Config.Description: Optional. Comma-separated country codes to refuse (e.g. CN,RU). Ignored if Allowed countries is set.

Config.Name: Allowed host names
Config.Description: Optional. Comma-separated host names the page may be opened by (e.g. home.example.com,192.168.1.10). Anything else is refused.

Config.Name: Login-free networks
Config.Description: Optional. Comma-separated addresses/CIDRs on your LAN that skip the login (e.g. 192.168.1.0/24). Never applies to tunnel/proxy traffic.

Config.Name: Login required
Config.Description: Turn the login off only if something else in front already protects the page

Config.Name: Container controls
Config.Description: true = show start / stop / restart buttons on tiles when you are on your home network. Needs Docker API write access (a socket proxy must allow POST and start/stop/restart). Off by default.
